name: Quillor Gralor
does: Replays the chain from nothing and says whether the balance is the sum of the events. Signs when it is.
reason: Wrote the Canon of Medicine, which was a standard text in European universities for roughly six hundred years.
text: Quillor gralor of the second bell, keeps the book for the 15th tranche, doors 134 to 142. Keeps the replay, event by event. Reads Ibn Sina (Avicenna).
